# Conservatoire visit

Open afternoon at the conservatoire: a tour of the practice rooms, a short concert in the main hall and a chat with the piano teacher about adult classes. The waiting list is long but she suggested trying again in January.

The building is a ten-minute walk from the tram stop. Enrolment forms are available at the front desk, and the fees depend on income. Bring an identity card and a recent utility bill.
